summary: An interactive website that combines datasets to allow exploration of analogous zones of the Arctic for Mars and the moon, along with features that simulate modifications of the Earth in order to explore possibilities of altering zones to better mirror Mars and the moon.
details:
Cryo-Strike combines datasets of the Arctic, Mars, and the moon in order to identify analogous zones on Earth. The project implements simulations of altercations to the Earth in order to make explore the possibility of creating more accurate analogous zones within the Arctic.

The project combines Python, Java, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.
